title: Beautiful but sheds way too much
text: Beautiful but sheds way too much. While this rug is in unique and beautiful, it sheds worse than a dog. It’s all over my couch pillow and blankets. I have had hair balls on my clothing etc. we do not own and have not owned pets…so it’s all the rug! Returning it. Sad because I loved the look. It shouldn’t be doing that for the price.
